0022600099.text: The Bucks (0-1) host the Bulls (0-1) in their second game of the 2026-27 season, with Milwaukee fourth in the Central and 13th in the East, one game back in the division. Chicago is 5th in the Central and 15th in the East, and it is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, while Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, Josh Giddey, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions with illness, a wrist injury, a knee injury and a quadriceps injury, respectively. The Bucks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, but the teams have not yet met this season, and in their most recent meeting, on March 1, 2026 in Chicago, the Bulls beat Milwaukee 120-97.
